Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The maven-dependency-tree package contains a shared component of Apache Maven,
which provides tree-based API for the resolution of Maven project dependencies.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the maven-dependency-tree package could not be built from the
source, because not all build dependencies were properly listed in the package.
The list of build dependencies has been amended, and it is now possible to build
the package from source as expected. (BZ#1074927)

Users of maven-dependency-tree are advised to upgrade to this updated package,
which fixes this bug.
